lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region, arranged in a staggered grid with 3 to 6 nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular clusters, creating a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A single elongated, dark-toned visual feature resembling a remora is visible near the ventral margin of the left pectoral fin.
